messages:
alex_j: Heads-up — reproducible packaging edge-case with the Python SDK. Editable install (Poetry 1.4 + pip 23.x) from a local checkout sometimes picks a cached wheel and the installed package lacks py.typed and async typing stubs. Breaks mypy and runtime typing checks. Anyone seen this?

mira_k: Steps + pyproject please, minimal repro?

alex_j: Minimal repro steps:
```bash
# workspace A: build wheel to simulate cached wheel
git clone git@github.com:redwood/inference-python-sdk tmp/sdk
cd tmp/sdk
python -m venv .venv && .venv/bin/pip install build
.venv/bin/python -m build -w
# workspace B: fresh venv and do editable install
python -m venv /tmp/testenv && /tmp/testenv/bin/pip install -e /path/to/tmp/sdk
```
Result: pip logs "Using cached ...redwood_sdk-0.1.2-py3-none-any.whl" and installed package missing redwood_sdk/py.typed.

samuel: This matches PEP 660 + cache behavior. If a prebuilt wheel exists with same name+version, pip may treat path install as satisfied by that wheel.

priya: Workarounds: `pip install --no-binary=:all: -e .` or `pip cache purge`. Poetry's editable add can also create lock entries that point to a built artifact if versions match.

alex_j: Log snippet:
```
Processing /path/to/tmp/sdk
Using cached /home/runner/.cache/pip/wheels/redwood_sdk-0.1.2-py3-none-any.whl
Installing collected packages: redwood-sdk
Successfully installed redwood-sdk-0.1.2
# Inspecting package: missing py.typed
```

mira_k: If wheel lacks py.typed, it's a packaging bug. Ensure py.typed is included (PEP 561) via pyproject include or MANIFEST.

samuel: Fix plan: 1) include py.typed and any stubs in built artifacts, 2) CI check that inspects wheel contents before publishing. Also doc note about clearing cache when doing editable dev.

priya: Filed a ticket and started a PR to add py.typed and update pyproject include; added a GH Action that lists whl contents and asserts on py.typed. Branch: devex/packaging-fixes.

ci-bot: CI failure: tests/type_checks.py::test_mypy — error "Missing py.typed marker". Will re-run after PR.

alex_j: Also note platform wheel tags — cached manylinux wheels vs local pure-python editable can interact. Suggest dev script to purge cache and install editable.

mira_k: I'll add CONTRIBUTING note: for editable installs run `pip cache purge` or use `pip install --no-binary=:all:`. Add a tox env that does an editable install smoke test.

samuel: Suggest `scripts/dev_install.sh` to standardize dev setup: show cache dir, purge, then `pip install -e .`.

priya: Pushed packaging fixes and CI check. Please test on your platforms and paste `pip debug` if issue persists.

alex_j: Will test on macOS ARM tonight and report back.
